note: Kit-autonomy gauntlet 2026-08-02. Guillotine (base) — MG / Attacker / Electric / Burst III, Elysion, slug `guillotine` (the MG/Electric BASE berserker; NOT `guillotine-winter-slayer`, the AR/Water Hero-Level kit). HP-SUBSTRAKE UNIT: her design center is a self HP-drain (S1 'HP ▼2.01%' per 30-NA proc) that opens two HP-threshold gates (S2 'HP<70%' and burst 'HP<50%'). MODEL (cross-family S2b claude-fable-5 converged; driver S0 had under-modeled the HP subsystem as UNMODELED/ungated, the reviewer correctly pushed it onto the engine's resource-counter primitive): the self-drain is a live resource pool 'hpLost' (0..100, +2.01 per 30-NA proc) — the kit's ONLY HP-loss source in the no-boss-damage sim, exactly the soda-twinkling-bunny / phantom / marciana / e-h resource machinery. The two HP gates then read that pool: S2's ATK scaler is a perResource atkPct (hpLost×0.96, live re-read each frame — sim.ts:1483 'ignores the static value') behind a resourceGate{hpLost min:30}; the burst's additional hit is a resourceGate{hpLost min:50} flatDamage rider (flatDamage has NO perResource field — laplace-ultimate-hero precedent: gated riders are the faithful encoding of a conditional additional hit). MODEL (6 load-bearing lines): SKILL1 — (S1a) hitCount:30 -> self critRatePct 9.28 /10s ('Activates after landing 30 normal attack(s). Critical Rate ▲9.28% for 10 sec'; GENERIC crit rate — no 'of normal attacks' qualifier, so critRatePct not critRateNormalPct; hitCount +hitsPerShot/shot, MG hitsPerShot 1 -> +1/bullet, refreshes every 30 bullets, 10s window bridges -> near-permanent after the first 30 hits). (S1b) hitCount:30 -> self resource hpLost +2.01 ('HP ▼2.01%' — the self HP COST, modeled as the hpLost counter that feeds the two gates; NOT simulated as an HP pool / damage / heal — inert as HP, load-bearing as the gate enabler; +2.01 additive-of-max per proc, the current-vs-max reading is ambiguous ⚑4). SKILL2 — (S2a) hitCount:150 -> self critDamagePct 14.69 /5s ('after landing 150 normal attack(s). Critical Damage ▲14.69% for 5 sec'; INDEPENDENT counter from S1's 30-hit; 150 hits >> 5s window -> genuinely partial uptime, the buff lapses between procs). (S2b) hitCount:30 + resourceGate{hpLost min:30} -> self atkPct perResource{hpLost, 0.96} /10s ('when HP falls below 70% ... ATK ▲0.96% continuously for every 1% of HP lost'; HP<70% == hpLost>=30; the perResource gives ATK% = hpLost×0.96 live, so +28.8% at the gate, growing as she drains; 'continuously' = live per-frame re-read). TRIGGER NOTE: this is hitCount:30, NOT passive — a passive block fires ONCE at frame 0 (sim.ts:2651) where hpLost=0, so passive+resourceGate{min:30} would lock the buff permanently OFF (the cross-family reviewer itself flagged this risk); the 30-hit re-trigger re-checks the gate every crossing, so the buff switches on at the first crossing after hpLost>=30 (~15th proc) and refreshes every 30 hits thereafter (10s window bridges the ~3s cadence -> continuous once open). BURST — (Ba) burstCast -> enemy flatDamage 1237.5 ('Affects the enemy with the highest final ATK. Deals 1237.5% of final ATK as Burst Skill damage'; highest-final-ATK = the single boss; burstCast resolves pre-FB so no +50% FB major, no range bonus — engine defaults; crit-eligible). (Bb) burstCast + resourceGate{hpLost min:50} -> enemy flatDamage 1237.5 ('Affects the same target when the skill user's HP falls below 50%. Deals 1237.5% of final ATK as additional damage'; HP<50% == hpLost>=50; burstCast re-fires each cast so the gate is re-checked — early casts at hpLost<50 deal ONE nuke, later casts deal TWO; this is faithful gating, NOT the ungated over-credit the driver first shipped). burstCast (her OWN cast), NOT fullBurstEnter — the control fixture carries helm as co-B3, so team FBs != her casts and fullBurstEnter would over-fire. UNMODELED: none — every kit line is represented (the HP drain as the hpLost resource, the two gates via resourceGate, the scaler via perResource). NO `ignored` blocks. ⚑ FLAGS (estimate + recipe + tier): ⚑1 CADENCE TUPLE [mandatory]: MG pullsPerSec / reloadFrames 171 datamine-unverified — drives the hitCount:30/150 crossing cadence, the hpLost accumulation rate, and thus the gate-crossing timing + proc counts. Estimate = datamine as-is. Recipe = rounds/min + reload gap from a focus video. ⚑2 HP-GATE TIMING [low-moderate]: the hpLost pool accrues from SELF-DRAIN ONLY (+2.01/30 hits); real fights also take boss damage, so HP<70% (hpLost 30, ~15 procs/~450 hits) and HP<50% (hpLost 50, ~25 procs/~750 hits) cross EARLIER in reality — the sim delays both gates, slightly UNDER-crediting S2b's ramp and Bb's additional hits early. The gate MAGNITUDES are kit-exact (0.96 mult; 1237.5 rider); only the crossing WALL-CLOCK is ⚑. Recipe = HP-bar crossing times from a focus video. ⚑3 GATE OFF-BY-ONE [low]: S1b (drain +2.01) and S2b (gate min:30) share the hitCount:30 trigger; depending on block-dispatch order the gate may open on the 15th or 16th crossing (hpLost 30.15 vs 28.14 at the check) — a one-proc (~3s) ambiguity, negligible. ⚑4 DRAIN AMBIGUITY [low]: 'HP ▼2.01%' current-vs-max reading unspecified (contrast scarlet's explicit 'Current HP ▼4.01%'); modeled additive-of-max (resource +2.01/proc). Multiplicative-of-current (×0.9799/proc) would slow the accrual (HP<70% at ~18 procs, HP<50% at ~34) — delays the gates a few procs, same direction as ⚑2. Recipe = focus-video HP-bar decay per proc. ⚑5 HEAL INTERACTION [low, S7 judge kimi-code/k3]: hpLost is MONOTONE (no decrement) — engine heals carry no HP amount, so a healing ally (liter) cannot retreat the below-70%/below-50% thresholds; once crossed the gates never close, over-crediting S2b/Bb vs a healed real fight (the boss-damage direction ⚑2 under-credits, this over-credits). No v1 behavioral change possible (nothing to wire). Recipe = focus-video HP-bar refill per heal tick with a healing B1; enact only if an HP-amount heal primitive lands. TIER 2: HP status-gates (resourceGate on S2b + Bb), a live perResource scaler, NA round-counts (hitCount 30/150), meta-defining berserker self-drain. Cross-family: S2b claude-fable-5 (converged on the resource-pool model), S5/S6 claude-opus-5, S7 kimi-code/k3 — see scripts/kit-autonomy/results/guillotine.json + manual-review/guillotine.md.

skill2: the HP<70% '→ ATK ▲0.96% per 1% HP lost' buff is a perResource atkPct (hpLost×0.96, live) behind resourceGate{hpLost min:30}; the gate MAGNITUDE is kit-exact, the crossing WALL-CLOCK is self-drain-only (real fights cross earlier via boss damage, ⚑2); the trigger is hitCount:30 (re-checks the gate) NOT passive (which would lock off at frame 0)
